verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage returns screening outcomes in machine-readable form. Synchronous screening suits real-time onboarding, and the WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhook exposes a `customer-screening.step_output.screening_result` field for detecting hits. Customer risk scores are configurable, and alerts, risks and case decisions are available through an API documented by a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema. missing for 10: explicit documentation of failure-reason codes or error taxonomy an agent can branch on, detail on the risk-signal fields within the result payload, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated branching on results.
